jobs.title: 250 Pages - Word file Typing
jobs.description:
I have a 250-page manuscript written by hand in English that I need transcribed into Microsoft Word. All pages are already scanned and organised; what I require is accurate typing, not OCR, delivered as plain text with only the most basic heading structure (no need to replicate the exact handwritten layout or add sophisticated formatting).

Accuracy is critical—spelling, punctuation, and paragraph breaks must mirror the source. Where handwriting is unclear, please flag the word in brackets so I can review it later. A single Word (.docx) file is fine; name it with today’s date when you submit.
